as_told.title: Tom DeLonge told Jesse over breakfast the phenomenon is archons

plain: The musician Tom DeLonge, who co-founded To the Stars Academy, a private company that researched UFOs, is said to believe that many of the non-human intelligences behind UFOs are not friendly, and may be what he called archons. Michels tells this from a breakfast he had with DeLonge, and says DeLonge told him "he thought these were like archons." In one telling Michels adds that DeLonge was drawing on Gnostic thought, an ancient religious tradition in which archons are powers that rule over and hold back humanity, which is why the remark matters: it would make the visitors something like jailers.
